tools.name: check_receipt
tools.description: Check one Costco warehouse receipt for price adjustments. An item can get one when it was bought in the last 30 days and a sale on the same item number started after the purchase and is running today, at the warehouse where it was bought (a sale only at another warehouse within 15 miles is reported

tools.name: warehouse_deals
tools.description: List the current in-warehouse deals (instant savings) at one Costco warehouse, from the site's copy of that warehouse's deals: item number, name, discount, regular price, price after the discount, dates, stock and department. Use it to answer "what is on sale at my Costco?". It does not fetch from C

tools.name: find_warehouse
tools.description: Find a Costco warehouse number by city name and/or US state (name or two-letter code). Each result has the warehouse number, city, state, its page on this site and how fresh its deals are. There is no zip code search; use the city name. The warehouse number is also printed on the receipt.

tools.name: track_receipt
tools.description: Sign the user up for 30 days of email alerts on one Costco receipt: the site emails them when something on it goes on sale, the same as forwarding the receipt to the site. Use it ONLY when the user has asked for ongoing alerts and has given you their email address themselves; never guess or look up

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_receipt, track_receipt · Private data: track_receipt · Public sink: check_receipt, track_receipt · Destructive: track_receipt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_receipt, track_receipt · Private data: track_receipt · Public sink: check_receipt, track_receipt · Destructive: track_receipt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
